operations.from: Corpok ta pon noka, cinuyep rehe, noka a=tuye pororu newa cinuyep a=sinnare hi a=nukare. Tan oruspe anak cinuyep a=kore aeywankep kor yak patek an.
operations.to: Corpok ta pon noka, cinuyep rehe newa noka kor pororu a=nukare. Noka a=tuye hene 「Upakno a=kar seri」 hene 「Upakno a=kar kewerihi」 hene ani pororu a=sinnare hene ki yakun, a=nukare pororu ka ne neno a=sinnare. Cinuyep kore aeywankep cinuyep a=sinnare hi ka kore yakun, nea hi ka a=nukare.
operations.meaning: The bottom tray displays thumbnail, name and current image dimensions; that one displayed size follows crop and any Same width or Same height adjustment. Only modification time depends on what the file provider supplies.

operations.from: A=sanke noka anak kikay kor memori akkari poro yakun, na pon noka numke yan.
operations.to: A=sanke noka a=kar hi ta, tane noka nuye kusu a=eywanke easkay RAM akkari na poronno RAM a=eywanke kuni a=ramu yakun, noka kor pororu a=numke uske a=nukare yakun, a=sanke kusu a=attupte noka na pon pe numke yan. A=sanke noka ponpon yakka nea RAM akkari na poronno RAM a=eywanke kuni a=ramu yakun, AN Paint anak noka kor pororu a=numke uske nukare ka somo ki no, RAM ehaye sekor an itak nukare.
operations.meaning: When creating the output is expected to need more than currently usable editing RAM, choose a smaller output copy only if the size chooser appears. If even a tiny output needs more than that budget, AN Paint shows a RAM-insufficiency message and does not show the size chooser.

review.disposition: Focused support for both exact final replacement chunks, medium idiom confidence.
review.tray_reason: One displayed value is established and then updated; no separate original/crop/normalized fields are asserted. hene ... hene ki groups crop versus normalization using either exact current caption. Provider condition attaches only to modification time.
review.memory_reason: Finite expected-use comparison preserves current working budget versus required RAM. Nested chooser-visibility condition avoids a universal offer. The tiny-output branch explicitly excludes the size chooser and supplies the warning instead.
review.limits: Current reviewer compositions, not attested fixed software sentences. No native-reader-certification gate. No complete-key or complete-catalogue acceptance; untouched inherited clauses retain their separate review status. Published modern neologisms are not declared universal or traditional terms.

consumer_evidence.finding: placedSize is crop dimensions if no normalization, otherwise dimensions normalized from that crop while preserving aspect ratio.
Tray renders one placedSize width x height. Provider modification time is optional. Output-size chooser is bypassed for memory warning when suggested size is null.
fits compares estimatedBytes to current workingBytes, plus bitmap pixel cap. suggested returns null when even 1x1 does not fit.

linguistic_evidence.type: Primary grammar and glossed speaker corpus
linguistic_evidence.supports: SOV ordering, participant marking and zero third-person marking. Explicit provider/application subjects take kore/nukare, not impersonal a= forms.
Finite proposition plus kuni a=ramu expresses expected/thought prospective state. We avoid unsupported long-distance relative extraction for the estimate.
akkari introduces the standard in comparative expressions; RAM is compared with RAM rather than output dimensions with installed device memory.

linguistic_evidence.type: Kayano primary dictionary, Saru; freshly indexed entry
linguistic_evidence.supports: ehaye means insufficient/lacking. The verified entry is between ehawkasu and ehaytahayta; exact headword is not inferred from a homonym.
ponpon qualifies a very small single fire, supporting intensive tiny rather than obligatory plural-only reading.

linguistic_evidence.type: Primary speaker text, printed p156 line145
linguistic_evidence.supports: Additional ponpon with singular fire, and kore giving in the following speaker passage.

linguistic_evidence.type: Primary modern glossary author's published proposals
linguistic_evidence.supports: pororu is explicitly labelled size, poro+ru, neologism. attupte is transitive copy attributed to Oota. We retain documented modern usage, not historical audit acceptance or an assertion of universal standard terminology.
